subject: Medford High School Building Committee Appointments
overview: The Medford School Committee approved appointments to the Medford High School Building Committee and received an administrative report on substitute teacher compensation and staffing shortages. The committee also restructured its subcommittees and referred a resolution on Autism Acceptance Month to committee.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Voted to convene in executive session to discuss strategy and preparation for negotiations with multiple bargaining units.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, including bills, payrolls, and past minutes, as amended to reflect a past abstention.

items.title: Superintendent's Updates and Comments
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent reported on monthly observances, upcoming school closures, middle school lotteries, high-scoring music and color guard groups, and administrative reports.

items.title: Acceptance of Donations
items.summary: Approved donations of $3,180.11 from the Medford Educational Foundation for Curtis Tufts keyboards, $500 from the Rotary Club for media technology, and $500 from the Kiwanis Club for culinary arts.

items.title: Substitute Teacher Supply, Demand, and Pay Report
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent Dr. Galusi presented data on substitute shortages, daily pay rates, coverage costs, and recommendations to adjust rates and explore staffing agencies.

items.title: Recognition of Autism Acceptance Month
items.summary: Referred a resolution recognizing Autism Acceptance Month and reviewing district ASD support services to the Behavioral Health and Special Education Subcommittee.

items.title: Revised Subcommittee Structure
items.summary: Approved a revised committee and subcommittee roster accommodating Member Intoppa following a recent vacancy.

items.title: Medford High School Building Committee Update and Appointments
items.summary: Appointed seven community members, two elected voting representatives, one non-voting member, and approved bringing two additional non-voting applicants forward at the next meeting for the high school MSBA project committee.

items.title: Revised School Handbooks Submission Schedule
items.summary: Voted to receive the draft school handbooks and schedule final submission for May 6, 2024.

items.title: Suspension and Discipline Report Schedule
items.summary: Approved presenting the final district-wide suspension and discipline report on April 29, 2024.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: Offered condolences to the families of Gladys Gomez and retired teacher Prudence Penny Lolo.
